title: UnifiedDB U2 — Causal Polyglot Placement Fabric
summary: Unified semantics/query contracts remain the target, but physical placement is decomposed into transaction, data, index, compute, process and fault-domain axes. Every result receives an admissibility class so exact facts, exact derived values, approximate candidates, salience and model-internal state cannot be implicitly flattened. Canonical commit + durable derivation replay and one-engine atomicity both survived the constructed recovery family; the replayable outbox carried measurable write overhead. Selection integrity is separate from record provenance and from replay integrity. External evidence contains strong examples both for integrated cross-modal query execution and for decoupled vector/index storage, so physical placement remains workload-specific.
